movieTitle: Đại Chiến Kỷ Phấn Trắng: Tàn Tích Hỏa Ngục
script: Một kỵ sĩ cơ giáp bạc đứng trên đỉnh tháp Neo-Hanoi dưới mưa đêm, rút kiếm ánh sáng Plasma lao xuống chém đôi chiến hạm Drone rồi đáp xuống quảng trường.

shots.subtitleVi: Hai đại quái thú đối đầu rực lửa bên dòng nham thạch cuộn trào.
shots.actionPromptEn: Wide Establishing Shot. Violent thunderstorm at night. On opposite banks of a bubbling molten lava river, @IGNIS REX unleashes [ACTION_INFERNO_ROAR] with fiery embers bursting from its jaws while @ABYSSAL SPINO executes [ACTION_ABYSS_STALK] with its cyan bioluminescent dorsal sail pulsing brightly. Rain sizzles into steam upon hitting the hot lava and IGNIS REX's glowing magma scales.
shots.endFramePromptEn: Wide profile freeze frame of the two prehistoric titans roaring face-to-face across the glowing red lava trench under torrential rain, jaws wide open, saliva and steam flying.
shots.vqqaNote: Strong adherence to the prompt with effective dual-bank framing, dynamic lighting contrast between the lava and bioluminescence, and solid subject posturing.

shots.titleVi: Cú Vồ Thủy Quái Liên Hoàn
shots.subtitleVi: Nanh vuốt phát sáng xanh lục lam xé toạc màn mưa nhắm thẳng vào yết hầu.
shots.actionPromptEn: Dynamic Tracking Shot. @ABYSSAL SPINO charges forward through the steam and splashing mud, unleashing [SKILL_2_BIO_PULSE] from its glowing cyan dorsal sail and striking with [SKILL_1_HYDRO_SLASH] — slashing its massive razor-sharp foreclaws and lunging its elongated crocodilian jaws at @IGNIS REX's armored neck, sending sparks and fiery embers flying.
shots.endFramePromptEn: Tight action freeze frame showing ABYSSAL SPINO clamping its jaws inches from IGNIS REX's throat, deadly talons slashing into basalt scales with glowing orange sparks illuminating the torrential rain.
shots.vqqaNote: Strong subject adherence and dynamic framing. Effectively visualizes both elemental dinosaurs, biological effects, and clashing forces with balanced environmental contrast.

shots.titleVi: Cú Ngoạm Dung Nham & Đòn Quật Đuôi Địa Chấn
shots.subtitleVi: Bạo chúa giáng trả đòn cắn dung nham sấm sét, quật văng đối thủ vào vách đá.
shots.actionPromptEn: Low-Angle Hero Shot. @IGNIS REX breaks free and counters with [SKILL_1_MAGMA_JAWS], locking its glowing molten teeth onto @ABYSSAL SPINO's neck, followed by [SKILL_2_SEISMIC_TAIL] — whipping its massive body and tail to hurl the Spinosaurus crashing heavily into a jagged obsidian cliff face, shattering volcanic boulders.
shots.endFramePromptEn: Low-angle impact frame showing ABYSSAL SPINO crashing into the shattered cliff wall surrounded by dust and falling rocks, while IGNIS REX stands tall with magma veins blazing.
shots.vqqaNote: Strong cinematic low-angle framing effectively captures the magma bite and cliff impact. Subject details align well with both character designs, though conveying two sequential skill actions simultaneously slightly crowds the kinetic readability.

shots.titleVi: Khúc Khải Hoàn Bạo Chúa Hỏa Ngục
shots.subtitleVi: Đỉnh cao thống trị giữa cuồng nộ của sấm sét và nham thạch.
shots.actionPromptEn: Low-Angle Hero Shot. @IGNIS REX mounts the apex of a colossal obsidian rock ledge overlooking the defeated rival and burning valley. Rain pours down its basalt armor as its molten red scars blaze with maximum intensity. @IGNIS REX unleashes its ultimate [ACTION_INFERNO_ROAR] into the stormy heavens just as a blinding fork of lightning splits the dark clouds behind its silhouette.
shots.endFramePromptEn: Epic cinematic master frame of IGNIS REX roaring skyward atop the rock pinnacle, silhouetted against a brilliant white lightning bolt and rolling volcanic storm clouds, steam rising into the night sky.
shots.vqqaNote: Strong adherence to the prompt elements, featuring the low-angle perspective, lightning silhouette, defeated rival, and molten basalt detailing in a well-balanced composition.
